Business Systems Architect (m/f/d) at TYTAN Technologies GmbH. Munich, Bayern, Germany. Apply for this Business Systems Architect (m/f/d) opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

TYTAN Technologies The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who thrive on ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty. We are looking for a Business Systems Architect to own and evolve the systems, tools, and processes that keep TYTAN running. As a company that designs and manufactures its own hardware and software, our operational landscape spans engineering, production, supply chain, and beyond, all of which need to be reflected in a coherent, well-connected tool and process architecture. With Odoo as our core ERP platform today, you will ensure our systems work seamlessly together, our processes are well-designed and continuously improving, and our digital landscape is ready for the next stage of growth. You will work closely with teams across the organization to translate business needs into smart, s calable workflows, and then build them. Your Roadmap to Make an Impact Systems Architecture & Roadmap Build and maintain the enterprise architecture across business capabilities, processes, data, and applications, building a lean digital thread from Requirements and Engineering through to Production and Service. Define and enforce standards across the stack: single source of truth, SSO, clean integrations, and compliance with ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and Export Control requirements. Anticipate when the current tool landscape needs to evolve, knowing when Odoo alone is not enough and when dedicated PLM, MES, or other systems are needed. Odoo Development & Customization Configure, customize, and extend Odoo modules using Python to match evolving business needs, owning upgrades, testing, and deployment across environments. Ensure data integrity, security, and performance of the Odoo platform while managing integrations with tools across CRM, finance, project management, and communication. Engineering, Production & Process Support and optimize workflows for BOM management, production planning, work orders, and quality control, ensuring system processes reflect how hardware and software are actually built. Work with stakeholders to map, document, and improve business processes eliminating bottlenecks, reducing manual workarounds, and maintaining documentation as the business evolves. Manage product lifecycle processes from prototyping and engineering changes through to serial production, while ensuring full traceability and documentation standards are met. AI & Automation Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities from Odoo's built-in capabilities to third-party tools and custom solutions to reduce manual work and improve accuracy Stay current on emerging AI and automation technologies and bring relevant ideas to the table 3–5 years of experience with ERP systems, with hands-on Odoo experience strongly preferred Solid Python development skills and familiarity with Odoo's OWL framework for customization and module development Proven experience mapping, documenting, and improving business processes with a strong understanding of how sales, procurement, inventory, production, and finance translate into system workflows Background in a manufacturing, engineering, or hardware-building environment is a strong plus Experience building and maintaining integrations between business systems via APIs, middleware, or native connectors, you see the full landscape and know how the pieces fit together Familiarity with AI/ML tools and workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier Awareness of ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and export control compliance in a systems context; Clear communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; fluent in English, German is a plus Why TYTAN? Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security. Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale. Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors. Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback. Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact. Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company. Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe. Our Benefits Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration About us At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all. WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process. Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.
